<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—dominant peak with a ~2 Da lower peak at ~77 % intensity and a ~2 Da higher peak at ~24 % intensity, matching the characteristic chlorine ³⁵Cl/³⁷Cl ratio (≈3:1) and the presence of a smaller +2 Da contribution consistent with sulfur’s ³⁴S isotope—we can definitively identify chlorine and sulfur in the sample.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl', 'S']</final_answer>
